items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: What were you playing in that show?

I was playing a couple of songs. Something Dave Nelson had wrote. Dave Nelson’s wife, colored woman, she had been with a great show that went to Russia. It was a sensation in Europe around 1921, ’20. Lot of shows, black shows, going all over Europe, being accepted in a civil . . . supposed to be savages ’til they see you on the stage doing that sophisticated [expletive deleted] and change your mind. They always show you as a babboon or the jungle. Always when it’s some black people, there was a jungle. Ape up in…
